description: This file contains R functions for directly accessing and manipulating Java objects within the SparkR backend, including calling Java methods, static methods, and creating new Java objects.

methods.name: sparkR.callJMethod
methods.description: Calls a Java method on a JVM object, returning the result as an R object or a JVM reference.

methods.name: sparkR.callJStatic
methods.description: Calls a static Java method in the JVM, returning the result as an R object or a JVM reference.

methods.name: sparkR.newJObject
methods.description: Creates a new Java object in the JVM and returns it as an R object or JVM reference.
